The parent session/run ID to identify is run-18e2499bcbbec778-bee1. Report what history you could actually read, with message IDs/sequences when available; if target/ID does not resolve, state that plainly and do not fabricate citations. Then inspect only the four specified workspace files orders.csv, payments.csv, refunds.csv, rules.md, plus relevant nested AGENTS.md. Do not alter source files. Use load_workspace_dependencies and a locally available runtime; create one reusable calculation script at .openharness-tmp/continuity_reconcile.py using file tools, then execute it via run_command access=read_only (no network, no package installs), printing a full auditable calculation/results summary. Report source data/rules, deduplication and refund decisions, numeric totals, exact script path, exact command/result and exit status. Do not spawn other agents. No network."}
